segments.he: מַתְנִי' הַמַּפֶּלֶת שָׁפִיר מָלֵא מַיִם, מָלֵא דָּם, מָלֵא גְּנִינִים — אֵינָהּ חוֹשֶׁשֶׁת לְוָלָד. וְאִם הָיָה מְרוּקָּם — תֵּשֵׁב לְזָכָר וְלִנְקֵבָה. הַמַּפֶּלֶת סַנְדָּל אוֹ שִׁלְיָא — תֵּשֵׁב לְזָכָר וְלִנְקֵבָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» A woman «who discharges a gestational sac full of fluid, full of blood,» or «full of» different «colors» need «not be concerned that» it was «an offspring. But if» the sac «was» one in which «tissue developed,» her halakhic status is that of a woman after childbirth. Since the sex of the embryo is unknown, the woman «observes» the strictures of a woman who gave birth both «to a male and to a female;» she is impure for fourteen days like a woman who gave birth to a female, but blood that she sees thereafter is pure only until forty days after birth, like a woman who gave birth to a male. A woman «who discharges a sandal» fetus, i.e., one that has the form of a sandal fish, «and» one who discharges «an afterbirth observes» the strictures of a woman who gave birth both «to a male and to a female.»

moves.summary: a sac full of water, blood or colors need not be treated as offspring
a sac with formed tissue: she observes the strictures of both male and female birth
a sandal-fetus or an afterbirth likewise requires both male and female periods

positions.claim: a sac full of water, blood or colors is not considered offspring; a formed sac, a sandal or an afterbirth obliges her to observe both male and female birth periods

principlesInvoked: ספק זכר ספק נקבה - תשב לזכר ולנקבה
